lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters in roughly four horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, with a cluster of three prominent spots forming a triangular vertex in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the circular spots, creating a non-uniform grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature extending from the post-branchial region toward the posterior, showing a sharp transition from high luminance on the dorsal side to shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense linear series of small circular high-intensity blobs along the leading edge of the visible pectoral fin.
